C-SERVICE-RESOLUTION-PROMOTION.IntentSummary: Execute the full bilingual project promotion and four execution steps explicitly approved with “proceed” on 2026-10-06. Preserve retained source meaning, use the independent Delivery Pipeline boundary and common AICC style, verify, reconcile durable state, apply/archive, commit, push and publish.

T-001.Title: Project both retained editions into the overview and eight child documents with complete links and search.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Source text, tables, code and diagrams are retained, routed inside the project and packaged through the common build.

T-002.Title: Apply native project styling and accessible diagram reading controls.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Both editions and themes use shared presentation and compact content constructs; diagram expansion, zoom, fit, actual size, scrolling, closing and focus return work.

T-003.Title: Verify full source preservation, consumer paths and complete-site regressions.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit, static, repeat-build and browser checks prove complete content, local assets, navigation, search, responsive themes, shared feedback, no-script reading and temporary portable output.

T-004.Title: Reconcile durable ownership and evidence, apply/archive and publish the verified complete source.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Fresh final evidence passes, records close, committed source is pushed and published, and the served manifest and pages identify the release without losing concurrent work.
